passives.name: Unstable Earth
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from attacks other than Burst, Dual Attacks, and Skill Chains by [Buff_V_4076005_12_8], but increases the damage dealt by all enemies proportional to their Defense. Increases the Speed of Healer and Defender enemies by [Buff_V_4076005_12_14] and reduces damage dealt by Ranger enemies by [Buff_V_4076005_12_6_1]. At the start of battle, inflicts Bleeding and Poisoned on all enemies and allies for 9 turns. Increases damage dealt to non-Earth enemies and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Earth enemies and increases damage taken from them.
